name: Heron Lakes Golf Club
location: West Delta Park, North Portland, Multnomah County, Oregon
architects: Robert Trent Jones Sr. with Robert Trent Jones Jr. (Greenback, 1971); Robert Trent Jones Jr. (Great Blue, 1992)

dtm.source: DOGAMI lidar DIGITAL_TERRAIN_MODEL_MOSAIC (bare earth), exportImage at 1 m in EPSG:32610, box x 522200-524200 / y 5049000-5051000, fetched by the GitHub Actions workflow 2026-11-13 (release data-heron_lakes)

chm.source: DOGAMI lidar CANOPY_HEIGHT_MODEL_MOSAIC (highest hit minus bare earth), same box and date
chm.label: DOGAMI canopy height model

layouts.name: Heron Lakes Great Blue
layouts.scorecard_source: Third-party: stymie.golf's Great Blue card (par, men's handicap and yardage per hole for every tee set, ratings), read 2026-10-24 by the scouting chat (docs/scouting/heron_lakes/scorecard_sources.md, branch scouting/new-courses); every row adds up. GolfPass prints another card (other tee names, 20-45 yd off on 8, 16 and 17), not used. Unverified against the club's printed card.

layouts.name: Heron Lakes Greenback
layouts.scorecard_source: Third-party: stymie.golf's Greenback card, confirmed hole for hole by GolfPass, read 2026-10-24 by the scouting chat (docs/scouting/heron_lakes/scorecard_sources.md); every row adds up. Black rating/slope 72.0/132 from stymie. Unverified against the club's printed card.

attribution: Elevation and canopy height: Oregon Department of Geology and Mineral Industries (DOGAMI) lidar
Orthophoto (checks only): Oregon Statewide Imagery Program 2024
notes: Standing defaults (COURSE_BUILD.md 4.1), 2026-11-13: the longest tee set of each course (Great Blue Gold, Greenback Black) and it is the default; all water red; OB = the club's OSM boundary (both courses), roads inside it are cart paths, the driving range is OB; inland Pacific Northwest wind 1-7 mph; trees from DOGAMI lidar, trees in fairways or in the way of a centre-line drive removed and listed. Theme heron_lakes (new; the course chat's design).
